verdict.rationale: Phoenix documents an official remote MCP server: any MCP client such as Claude Code, Cursor or VS Code can point at the instance's /mcp endpoint to search, query and operate on projects, traces, datasets, experiments, prompts and annotations. A `px setup mcp --agent` command wires up popular agents, and the SDK also exposes span querying with filtering for programmatic access. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that aggregate metrics (latency/token stats) are queryable through the MCP/API, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven debugging via the MCP server.
